text: When ~ enters from anywhere other than a graveyard or exile, if it's on the battlefield and you control N or fewer creatures named ~, roll a N-sided die. N-N | Add {R}{R}{R}{R}. N-N | Add {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}. N-N | Add {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Except for creatures named ~ and artifact creatures, creatures you control can't attack.

At the beginning of your upkeep, if ~ is exiled with a scream counter on it, remove a scream counter from it. If there are no more scream counters on it, put it into your graveyard and each player returns all creature cards from their graveyard to the battlefield.
During your turn, ~'s power and toughness are each equal to N plus the number of Swamps your opponents control. During turns other than yours, ~'s power and toughness are each N.
Whenever ~ attacks, it gets +N/+N until end of turn for each other attacking ~.
{G}: Until end of turn, ~ can be the target of spells and abilities controlled by target player as though it didn't have shroud.
{X}, {T}: ~ deals half X damage, rounded down, to any target, and half X damage, rounded up, to you.
{T}, Untap a tapped land an opponent controls: Add one mana of any type that land could produce.
Target creature defending player controls can block any number of creatures this turn. It blocks each attacking creature this turn if able.
If target creature has toughness N or greater, it gets +N/-N until end of turn. Otherwise, it gets +N/-X until end of turn, where X is its toughness minus N.

Distribute three +N/+N counters among one, two, or three target creatures. For each +N/+N counter you put on a creature this way, remove a +N/+N counter from that creature at the beginning of the next cleanup step.
As long as you control another creature, prevent all damage that would be dealt to ~ by spells that target it.
You destroy four lands you control, then target opponent destroys four lands they control. Then ~ deals N damage to each creature.
When the chosen color isn't the most common color among nontoken permanents the chosen player controls or is tied for most common, sacrifice ~.
White creatures get +N/+N as long as the chosen color is the most common color among nontoken permanents the chosen player controls but isn't tied for most common.
Choose two target creatures controlled by the same player. Exile one of those creatures and put two +N/+N counters on the other.
When you play another land, sacrifice ~.
Whenever enchanted creature attacks and isn't blocked, you may have it assign no combat damage this turn. If you do, defending player discards a card at random.
At the beginning of your upkeep, destroy ~ unless you pay {N}{B}{B}{B}. If ~ is destroyed this way, it deals N damage to you.

When ~ is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, at the beginning of each of your upkeeps for the rest of the game, remove all mire counters from a land that a mire counter was put onto with ~ but that a mire counter has not been removed from with ~.
When the token leaves the battlefield, sacrifice ~.
When ~ leaves the battlefield, exile the token.
At the beginning of your upkeep, unless you pay {B}{B}{B}, tap ~ and sacrifice a land of an opponent's choice.
As ~ enters, sacrifice any number of creatures. ~'s power becomes the total power of those creatures and its toughness becomes their total toughness.

At end of combat, put a paralyzation counter on each creature blocking or blocked by ~ and tap those creatures. Each of those creatures doesn't untap during its controller's untap step for as long as it has a paralyzation counter on it. Each of those creatures gains "{N}: Remove a paralyzation counter from ~."

{N}{U}: Return target white or black creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. That creature gains "Cumulative upkeep {N}." If the creature would leave the battlefield, exile it instead of putting it anywhere else.
The next time a source of your choice would deal damage to you this turn, instead that source deals that much damage to you and ~ deals that much damage to that source's controller.

Whenever enchanted creature attacks and isn't blocked, its controller may have it deal damage equal to its power plus N to another target creature. If that player does, the attacking creature assigns no combat damage this turn.
Whenever you play a land, if it wasn't the first land you played this turn, ~ deals N damage to you.
You may play any number of lands on each of your turns.
If ~ would die, return it to its owner's hand instead. Until that player's next turn, that player plays with that card revealed in their hand and can't play it.
{N}, Discard a card: Put a +N/+N counter on ~ or ~ gains flying, first strike, or trample.

Target opponent chooses a card in your graveyard. You may pay {G}. If you do, repeat this process except that opponent can't choose a card already chosen for ~. Then put the last chosen card into your hand.
If a permanent with a wind counter on it would untap during its controller's untap step, remove all wind counters from it instead.

At the beginning of your upkeep, you may sacrifice a Forest. If you sacrifice a snow Forest this way, ~ gains trample until end of turn. If you don't sacrifice a Forest, sacrifice ~ and it deals N damage to you.

{N}, Sacrifice ~: Exchange control of target artifact, creature, or land you control and target permanent an opponent controls that shares one of those types with it. If those permanents are exchanged this way, destroy all Auras attached to them.
When ~ is put into your graveyard from the battlefield, you may shuffle ~ into your library.

As long as ~ is untapped, noncreature artifacts you control can't be enchanted, they have indestructible, and other players can't gain control of them. This effect doesn't remove Auras already attached to those artifacts.
At the beginning of your upkeep, ~'s base power and toughness become equal to the power and toughness of target creature other than ~ until the end of your next upkeep.
This turn, whenever an attacking creature deals combat damage to you, it deals that much damage to its controller.
When ~ enters, create X N/N Sand Warrior creature tokens that are red, green, and white at the beginning of your next upkeep, where X is the number of lands you control at that time.

{X}, {T}: Target opponent mills a card, then repeats this process until a creature card or X cards have been put into their graveyard this way, whichever comes first. If one or more creature cards were put into that graveyard this way, sacrifice ~ and put one of them onto the battlefield under your control. X can't be N.
{T}, Remove a charge counter from ~: Add ~'s last noted type and amount of mana. Spend this mana only to cast the last card exiled with ~.

{X}, {T}: You may exile a nonland card from your hand. You may cast that card for as long as it remains exiled. Put a charge counter on ~ and note the type and amount of mana spent to pay this activation cost. Activate only if there are no charge counters on ~.

{X}: You may choose a creature card in your hand whose mana cost could be paid by some amount of, or all of, the mana you spent on {X}. If you do, you may cast that card face down as a N/N creature spell without paying its mana cost. If the creature that spell becomes as it resolves has not been turned face up and would assign or deal damage, be dealt damage, or become tapped, instead it's turned face up and assigns or deals damage, is dealt damage, or becomes tapped. Activate only as a sorcery.
Search your library for three cards and reveal them. Target opponent chooses one. Put that card into your hand and the rest into your graveyard. Then shuffle.
If you would draw a card during your draw step, instead you may skip that draw. If you do, until your next turn, you can't be attacked except by creatures with flying and/or islandwalk.
At end of combat, tap all creatures that blocked ~ this turn. They don't untap during their controller's next untap step.

You and target player exchange control of the creature you each control with the greatest mana value. Then exchange control of artifacts the same way. If two or more permanents a player controls are tied for greatest, their controller chooses one of them.
As long as ~ is on the stack, spells that target it cost {N} more to cast.
At the beginning of each end step, if a creature dealt damage by ~ this turn died, put that card onto the battlefield under your control. Sacrifice it when you lose control of ~.
When enchanted land becomes tapped, destroy it. That land's controller may attach ~ to a land of their choice.
If an opponent who controls at least as many lands as you do would put a land onto the battlefield, that player instead puts that land onto the battlefield then sacrifices a land of their choice.
~ deals X damage to any target. If ~ would deal damage to a creature, that damage can't be prevented or dealt instead to another permanent or player.
Target player loses all poison counters. ~ deals that much damage to that player.
~ gets +N/+N as long as you control a permanent named Guan Yu, Sainted Warrior or a permanent named Zhang Fei, Fierce Warrior.
{N}, {T}, Sacrifice ~: Put up to four target basic land cards from a player's graveyard on top of their library in any order. That player draws a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
{N}{U}, {T}: Untap target artifact an opponent controls and gain control of it until end of turn. It gains haste until end of turn. When you lose control of the artifact, tap it.
At the beginning of your end step, you may reveal your hand and put all land cards from it onto the battlefield. If you do, discard your hand.
At the beginning of your upkeep, ~ deals N damage to you unless you sacrifice a creature other than ~. If ~ deals damage to you this way, tap it.
If ~ would enter, you may discard a land card instead. If you do, put ~ onto the battlefield. If you don't, put it into its owner's graveyard.
{T}: Put a music counter on target creature. If it doesn't have "At the beginning of your upkeep, destroy ~ unless you pay {N} for each music counter on it," it gains that ability.
{G}{W}, Discard a card: Put a +N/+N counter on target creature or that creature gains banding, first strike, or trample.
{X}, {T}: Choose a card name. Target opponent reveals X cards at random from their hand. Then that player discards all cards with that name revealed this way. Activate only during your turn.
{N}, {T}: Return target permanent you both own and control to your hand.
{T}: Gain control of target creature with power less than or equal to ~'s power for as long as ~ remains tapped and that creature's power remains less than or equal to ~'s power.
~ can't attack unless at least two other creatures attack.
~ can't block unless at least two other creatures block.
{T}: Target land becomes a Swamp until its controller's next untap step.
Whenever a creature enters, that creature's controller may have it deal damage equal to its power to any target of their choice.
{N}: The next N damage that would be dealt to ~ this turn is dealt to its owner instead. Only ~'s owner may activate this ability.
When ~'s power is N or greater, sacrifice it.
Counter target spell unless its controller pays {X}. If that player doesn't, they tap all lands with mana abilities they control and lose all unspent mana.

Each player loses a third of their life, then discards a third of the cards in their hand, then sacrifices a third of the creatures they control of their choice, then sacrifices a third of the lands they control of their choice. Round up each time.
As an additional cost to cast ~, you may pay {N}{R} and/or {N}{G} any number of times.
Destroy target artifact. For each additional {N}{R} you paid, destroy another target artifact. For each additional {N}{G} you paid, destroy another target artifact, and you gain N life.
At the beginning of your upkeep, if ~ started the turn untapped, put a dream counter on it.
{T}: ~ deals N damage to any target and doesn't untap during your next untap step.
{N}, {T}, Exile ~: The next time you would draw a card this turn, instead put a card you own from outside the game into your hand.
Discard any number of cards at random. Creatures you control get +N/+N until end of turn for each card discarded this way.
For each N damage that would be dealt to ~, if it has a +N/+N counter on it, remove a +N/+N counter from it and prevent that N damage.
At the beginning of your upkeep, put a wage counter on ~. You may pay {N} for each wage counter on it. If you don't, remove all wage counters from ~ and an opponent gains control of it.
Whenever a Swamp, Mountain, black permanent, or red permanent becomes tapped, ~ deals N damage to that permanent's controller.
Prevent the next N damage that would be dealt to any target this turn. If it's a creature, put a +N/+N counter on it for each N damage prevented this way at the beginning of the next end step.
Whenever a creature dealt damage by ~ this turn dies, put that card onto the battlefield under your control at the beginning of the next end step. Sacrifice the creature when you lose control of ~.
At the beginning of your upkeep, sacrifice a land. If you sacrifice an Island this way, ~ deals N damage to you.
Enchanted creature can't attack or block, and its activated abilities with {T} in their costs can't be activated.
{N}: Put the top card of your graveyard on the bottom of your library.

{T}: Choose two target blocking creatures controlled by the same opponent. If each of those creatures could block all creatures that the other is blocking, remove both of them from combat. Each one then blocks all creatures the other was blocking.
Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield. Put a +N/+N counter on that creature if the exiled creature was a Thrull.
Whenever a Sliver becomes blocked, that Sliver gets +N/+N until end of turn for each creature blocking it.
At the beginning of each end step, if ~ regenerated this turn, create a N/N blue Starfish creature token for each time it regenerated this turn.
Tap all blocking creatures. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt this turn. Each attacking creature and each blocking creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
{U}, Exile the top card of your library: If the exiled card is a snow land, ~ gets +N/+N until end of turn.
{T}, Sacrifice ~ and any number of creatures you control: ~ deals X damage to any target, where X is the total power of the creatures sacrificed this way, then exile ~ and those creature cards.

When enchanted creature dies, that creature's controller chooses a creature that ~ could enchant. If the player does, return ~ to the battlefield under your control attached to that creature. If they don't, return ~ to the battlefield under your control as a non-Aura enchantment. It loses "enchant creature" and gains "At the beginning of that player's upkeep, ~ deals N damage to that player."
Each attacking creature doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.

{N}, {T}: Exile target creature and all Auras attached to it. Note the number and kind of counters that were on that creature. When ~ leaves the battlefield or becomes untapped, return that exiled card to the battlefield under its owner's control tapped with the noted number and kind of counters on it. If you do, return the other exiled cards to the battlefield under their owner's control attached to that permanent.
Tap target creature. Prevent all combat damage that would be dealt by that creature this turn. It doesn't untap during its controller's next two untap steps.

At the beginning of your upkeep, you may remove any number of +N/+N counters from ~. If you do, create that many N/N colorless Tetravite artifact creature tokens. They each have flying and "~ can't be enchanted."
At the beginning of your upkeep, ~ deals N damage to each opponent and planeswalker it has dealt damage to this game.
If you would begin your turn while ~ is tapped, you may skip that turn instead. If you do, untap ~.

Each noncreature artifact loses all abilities and becomes an artifact creature with power and toughness each equal to its mana value. If ~ leaves the battlefield, this effect continues until end of turn.

Sacrifice an artifact. If you do, search your library for an artifact card. If that card's mana value is less than or equal to the sacrificed artifact's mana value, put it onto the battlefield. If it's greater, you may pay {X}, where X is the difference. If you do, put it onto the battlefield. If you don't, put it into its owner's graveyard. Then shuffle.

Sacrifice ~: Choose one. Activate only if there are two or more hatchling counters on ~. / • You may put a creature card from your hand onto the battlefield. / • Return target creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
{T}: Target creature loses first strike or swampwalk until end of turn.
{T}, Sacrifice ~: Look at a card at random in target player's hand. You draw a card at the beginning of the next turn's upkeep.
Whenever an artifact you control is put into a graveyard from the battlefield, if it wasn't sacrificed, you may pay {N}. If you do, draw a card.
{T}: Until end of turn, target creature has base power N or base toughness N.
As long as the top card of your graveyard is a creature card, ~ has the full text of that card and has the text "{N}: Discard a card."
At the beginning of your upkeep, put a +N/+N counter on ~ if it has blocked or been blocked since your last upkeep. Otherwise, remove a +N/+N counter from it.
Tap X target creatures. ~ deals N damage to each of those creatures with flying.
{B}: ~ deals N damage to each creature and each player. Activate no more times each turn than the number of snow Swamps you control.
~'s power and toughness are each equal to the number of Forests sacrificed as it entered.
{T}: Until your next upkeep, target noncreature artifact becomes an artifact creature with power and toughness each equal to its mana value.
Whenever ~ blocks, flip a coin. If you lose the flip, remove ~ from combat and it can't block this turn. Creatures it was blocking that had become blocked by only ~ this combat become unblocked.
